prompts.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create ONE finished landscape strategy educational infographic, high-resolution, approximately 2400x1600, readable and polished. Input image 1 is a STYLE AND LAYOUT REFERENCE ONLY. Match its black trading-terminal backdrop, subtle grid, crisp green/red Heikin Ashi candles, blue upper Bollinger line, magenta middle line, orange VWAP, cyan section headings, thin cyan/green/red bordered black panels, annotated candle highlights, arrows and bottom summary panels. Redesign its content completely for the precise strategy below. Deliver one complete poster, NOT a collage of four posters.

Use generous margins, sharp large typography, exact legible English wording and coherent chart geometry. Use concise text and avoid filling the poster with tiny writing. Place the title at top, 3 compact reference boxes below, a large annotated candlestick chart occupying the central half, and 3 compact bottom panels. Distinguish Heikin Ashi chart candles from actual observed LTP execution: price exits are observed LTP triggers, never HA-close triggers. The chart is an illustrative schematic, not historical data.
Top indicators box text:
"INDICATORS"
"1-minute Heikin Ashi"
"BB: 20 HA closes, 2 population SD"
"Session VWAP: raw typical price × volume"
Top session box text:
"SESSION & EXECUTION"
"09:15–15:00 IST · NSE weekdays"
"Sandbox MARKET orders · long only"
"At 15:00: exit on a fresh quote"
Bottom risk box exact text:
"STOP & SIZE"
"₹10,000 notional per entry · whole shares"
"Stop = floor((signal HA low × 0.9997) / tick) × tick"
"R = confirmed entry fill − stop"
"3R level = entry + 3R, rounded UP to tick"
"Forward quantity = floor(10000 / max(LTP, ask))"
Bottom worked example exact text:
"ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE"
"Signal HA low ₹99.80 · tick ₹0.05"
"Entry ₹100.40 · stop ₹99.75"
"Risk ₹0.65/share · 3R ₹102.35"
"99 shares · ₹9,939.60 entry notional"
Bottom notes:
"One open position per symbol per strategy"
"Fresh-signal re-entry allowed after exit"
"Signal valid only during the next minute"
"Stops/targets trigger MARKET exits; fills may differ"
Footer: "Illustrative prices, not market data or backtest results. Current code rules · 30 Sep 2026."
Critical accuracy constraints: NO 5-minute timeframe; NO 09:20 start; NO 15:20 square-off; NO leverage multiplier; NO ₹50,000 or ₹1 lakh sizing; NO max-three-trades rule; NO requirement to wait for entry-candle close; NO claim that HA close must cross an upper band. The signal requires HA HIGH above upper BB, not HA close. Preserve all exact inequalities. Show original stop as a straight horizontal red dashed line throughout. Small legend: BB upper (blue), BB middle (magenta), VWAP (orange), original stop (red dashed), 3R (yellow dashed).

TITLE exact: "NIFTY500 SCANNER · TRAIL AFTER 3R"
Subtitle: "BB + VWAP + HEIKIN ASHI · 1-MINUTE · ₹10,000"
Small source-file label: "Nifty500_Scanner_Trail_3R_10K.py"
Top-left universe box exact text:
"STOCK FILTER"
"Nifty500 stocks only"
"Top 50 positive gainers OR"
"Top 50 positive volume shockers"
"RVOL > 1; prior 5 full sessions' average"
"Dynamic union; recheck at entry"
Main chart sections:
"1. COMPLETED SIGNAL" then "2. NEXT-MINUTE ENTRY" then "3. ARM AT 3R" then "4. BB-MIDDLE EXIT".
Signal callout exact text: "Green HA · no lower wick" / "HA high > BB upper" / "HA low > VWAP" / "Entire HA candle above VWAP".
Entry callout exact text: "Immediately next minute" / "LTP > signal HA high and forming BB upper" / "Forming HA green · no lower wick" / "Forming HA low > VWAP" / "BUY before candle close".
Show highlighted completed signal candle at 10:00 and adjacent forming-entry candle at 10:01. The price rises to first reach yellow horizontal 3R ₹102.35 at 10:05. Mark it with yellow arrow "ARM ONLY — DO NOT SELL". Price rises further to ₹103.20, then drops to actual LTP ₹102.40 below magenta forming BB middle ₹102.50 at 10:09. Red arrow SELL points at the observed LTP dot below the magenta line, no candle-close implication.
Exit callout exact text: "After 3R activation:" / "SELL ALL on first observed LTP < forming BB middle" / "No candle-close wait".
Prominent banner exact text: "3R ACTIVATES TRAILING — ORIGINAL STOP STAYS FIXED".
Notes under chart: "Before 3R: ignore BB-middle exit" / "Stop and 15:00 cutoff remain active" / "No partial sale · no breakeven move · 3R profit is not locked".
Never draw a ratcheting stop; the magenta middle is a moving indicator, not a monotonic stop. Label time axis 10:00,10:01,10:03,10:05,10:07,10:09. Caption: "Signal → breakout BUY → 3R arms → observed LTP below middle → SELL".
